subject: Regional failover & VPC evidence request — NorthStar Health
messages:
From: Julie Hartman <julie.hartman@northstar-health.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@northstar-health.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Regional processing & DR failover questions

Rafael — thanks for taking the time yesterday. A few follow-ups from our security/compliance team after reviewing the SOC 2 and your product brief: they need documented answers and some artifacts before our procurement can advance. Short list below (we've attached a preliminary SIG matrix and our suggested DPA redlines):

1) Data residency guarantee: we require EU-only processing for primary operations. We also need a documented DR/failover policy that explains any circumstances under which data may be processed in the US (and exact controls that minimize residency risk).
2) Evidence for controls: SOC 2 Type II report, CAIQ/consensus answers, and a SIG-lite spreadsheet that maps to our risk categories.
3) VPC/private connectivity: technical design for your Private deployment (VPC peering, Private Connect), plus KMS/HSM model for key custody and whether Redwood or customer keys are used.
4) Data deletion/retention: timelines for complete deletion on request (hosted API vs Dedicated/Private) including residual copies, backup retention, and eDiscovery support.
5) DPIA inputs: any template notes Redwood can provide to feed our DPIA (processing categories, categories of data, subprocessors in DR regions).

Can you confirm whether you can provide evidence for the above and an ETA? We are on a tight timeline for the Board review (two weeks).

Attachments: northstar_sig_matrix.xlsx, dpa_redlines_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Julie
Head of Security, NorthStar Health

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Julie Hartman <julie.hartman@northstar-health.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Regional processing & DR failover questions

Julie — appreciate the clear list. Short answer: yes, we can provide what you're asking for. Below is a concise mapping and proposed next steps; I put Kimberly (legal/agreements) and Priyom (infrastructure) on copy for technical attachments and timelines.

Summary mapping:
- EU primary processing: supported for both Hosted API (regional tenancy) and Private deployment. We can provide an explicit contractual clause that binds processing to the EU region for the primary tenant.
- DR/failover: Redwood supports a documented failover mode where, under declared disaster scenarios, requests may route to a pre-provisioned US failover cluster. We will supply the exact trigger conditions and mitigations. We also have an isolation playbook that minimizes persisted EU customer data in US during failover; short-term KV cache may be in DR region only, backed by wipe procedures.
- Evidence: attaching an evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, CAIQ export, SIG mapping).
- VPC & keys: Private offers VPC peering or Private Connect. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK) or Redwood-managed HSM with audit logs.
- Deletion: hosted API: token-level/retention policy and deletion timeline (30 days for backups, immediate deletion of customer data on request subject to eDiscovery holds). Dedicated/Private: we give customer full control and can provide certified wipe evidence on decommission.
- DPIA inputs: we will share a starter DPIA table to populate.

Next steps I propose:
1) We will upload an evidence bundle by EOD Thursday (2027-05-27) with SOC 2 summary, CAIQ/consensus export, and technical runbook for VPC + failover.
2) Priyom will follow up with a short technical diagram and KMS options by Friday.
3) Kimberly will review your DPA redlines and aim to respond with comments in 3 business days.

If the Board needs a single package, we can produce a signed attestation for regional processing constraints and a DR runbook that includes a failover whitelist and timeline. Does that work?

Best,
Rafael
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-evidence-bundle-NSH-20270530.zip (will be uploaded to shared Drive)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Regional processing & DR failover questions — internal notes

Forwarding Julie's request — internal notes below (Priyom please add technical specifics):

- Legal: DPA redlines look pretty standard; NSH wants a hard EU-only clause for primary processing and a carve-out for DR with strong notice and scope limits. We should prepare a short addendum: "Primary Processing Location: EU; DR only where expressly invoked by Redwood under emergency conditions; Redwood will provide written notice and purge plan within X hours."
- Evidence bundle: compile SOC 2 Type II summary (not full report unless NDA), CAIQ answers export, SIG-lite with mapping to NorthStar risk categories. Also include our runbook: failover triggers, expected duration, manual rollback steps, KMS ownership options, and wipe confirmation artifacts.
- Tech ask for Priyom: provide a diagram (EU region primary, SRE-run DR cluster in US), details on KV cache purging timeline, backup retention for hosted vs dedicated, and whether cross-region replication is ever enabled by default. Also confirm HSM audit log retention and availability for customer review.

Action owners: Priyom (tech bundle) — due EOD 27 May; Rafael (evidence package + attestation) — due 27 May; Kimberly (DPA comments) — due 1 June.

-Kim

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Julie Hartman <julie.hartman@northstar-health.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Regional processing & DR failover questions — technical attachments

Julie / Kim / Rafael — attaching the technical deliverables and short answers inline. I've also uploaded diagrams and scripts to the Drive link included in the evidence bundle.

Key technical points (summary):
- Primary processing: EU region only for customer tenant; all request processing and persisted artifacts are routed to eu-west-1 clusters by default. No cross-region replication is performed for LLMKV stores for EU-only tenants.
- Failover model: we maintain a cold standby in us-east-1 for DR. Failover is executed only when our SRE lead declares a region outage AND after runbook checklist. During failover, ephemeral KV cache is rebuilt from snapshots; however, we do not replicate customer PII to the US. If any temporary processing occurs in the US (rare, <1% of cases historically), we will: (a) notify customer within 24 hours, (b) initiate a purge of persisted artifacts, and (c) produce a purge certificate.
- Backups & retention: hosted API backups are retained for 30 days; snapshots for Dedicated are retained per contract (default 90 days) and can be shortened. We can provide a certified deletion/crypto-wipe report when requested for Dedicated nodes.
- KMS/HSM: we offer BYOK with customer-managed keys in cloud KMS or Redwood-managed HSM with FIPS 140-2 modules. Audit logs for HSM operations are retained 1 year by default and we can expose audited records through a secure portal under NDA.
- Evidence included: SOC 2 Type II executive summary, CAIQ JSON export, SIG mapping, VPC/peering diagram, failover runbook, sample purge certificate.

Links / attachments: redwood-evidence-bundle-NSH-20270530.zip (Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-NSH-evidence-20270530)

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough with an SRE on Thursday.

Thanks,
Priyom
Principal Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
